library.unifiedIntro.source: 统一查找布局、坐标评价、编辑副本和信号实验。每条记录保留自己的评价协议与原布局关联。
library.unifiedIntro.en: Find layouts, coordinate evaluations, edited copies and signal experiments together. Each record retains its evaluation protocol and original-layout association.

library.related.source: 同一原布局的关联记录
library.related.en: Records associated with this original layout

library.relatedIntro.source: 编辑副本与信号实验分别关联原布局；信号实验使用其记录指定的完整布局。
library.relatedIntro.en: Edited copies and signal experiments each refer to their original layout. Signal experiments use the complete layout specified in their record.

library.editorFetchError.source: 电极编辑记录未载入，请刷新记录。
library.editorFetchError.en: Electrode editing records could not be loaded. Refresh the records.

library.editorDetails.source: 编辑评分使用独立协议。载入后恢复这条记录的点位；重新评价时检查模型、原布局与缓存。
library.editorDetails.en: Editing scores use a separate protocol. Loading restores this record's electrode positions; re-evaluation checks the model, original layout and cache.

library.sourceDetails.source: 打开后恢复源模式、源位置、波形、干扰幅度与随机种子，并检查该场景的已有缓存。
library.sourceDetails.en: Opening restores source mode and positions, waveform, artifact amplitude and random seed, and checks the saved cache for this scenario.

library.legacyDetails.source: 历史信号协议保留原结果下载；当前信号页面使用不同源分区，不能直接恢复这个场景。
library.legacyDetails.en: Historical signal results remain available for download. The current signal workspace uses different source regions and cannot directly restore this scenario.

library.missingSummary.source: 这条旧任务未保存指标摘要，查看或下载结果时读取完整记录。
library.missingSummary.en: This older task has no saved metric summary. Viewing or downloading loads the complete record.

library.invalidEditorKey.source: 编辑记录编号无效，请从记录列表重新选择。
library.invalidEditorKey.en: The edited record ID is invalid. Select it again from the records.

library.missingEditor.source: 指定编辑记录无法读取，或与原布局不一致。
library.missingEditor.en: The specified edited record is unavailable or does not match the original layout.

library.supersededShown.source: 已显示较早代码版本的同配置记录。
library.supersededShown.en: Records with the same configuration from earlier code versions are shown.

library.supersededFolded.source: 另有{{0}}条同配置记录来自较早的代码版本，已折叠。
library.supersededFolded.en: {{0}} more records with the same configuration come from earlier code versions and are folded.

library.chooseHint.source: 点击“查看结果”打开记录详情。
library.chooseHint.en: Choose “View results” to open a record’s details.

library.workspaceScope.source: 信号实验只列出此工作区完成的任务，较早的任务可能已不在列表中。筛选记录不会读取完整波形或启动计算。
library.workspaceScope.en: Signal experiments list only tasks completed in this workspace; older tasks may no longer be listed. Filtering neither loads full waveforms nor starts computation.

library.otherWorkspaces.source: 其他工作区的信号实验不在此列出；在信号仿真页重新选择相同场景即可直接读取已保存的结果。
library.otherWorkspaces.en: Signal experiments from other workspaces are not listed here; choosing the same scenario again on the signal simulation page reads its saved result directly.

library.workspaceSourceFetchError.source: 此工作区的信号记录未载入，请刷新记录。
library.workspaceSourceFetchError.en: Signal records of this workspace could not be loaded. Refresh the records.
